info.title: وريد / Warid — Patient app API
info.description:
The endpoints a native patient app may call — nothing else.

Generated by `npx tsx scripts/generate-openapi.ts` from the route files and
the Zod schemas the server validates with, then filtered to the three groups
a PATIENT token can reach. Every other endpoint in this codebase would answer
403 to this app, so none of them are here.

Read `docs/api/README.md` for the conventions a schema cannot express:
refresh-token rotation and its reuse detection, Baghdad-day bucketing, money
as a JSON number, and that 404 also means "not yours".

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /api/auth/token. Valid 15 minutes; refresh with POST /api/auth/token/refresh. If this header is present its verdict is final — the server never falls back to a cookie.

error.description: Human-readable Arabic. Not stable — do not branch on it.

code.description: The machine-readable contract. Branch on this.

details.description: Present on VALIDATION_FAILED. `field` is a dot path into the body you sent.

nextCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor over (createdAt, id). Do not parse or construct it.

total.description: Only when explicitly requested — COUNT(*) is a scan.

404.description: Not found — or not yours; the two are deliberately indistinguishable

422.description: Refused by a domain rule — `error` explains why

500.description: Server fault — retry with backoff and quote `requestId`
